text:
Rhea: Dropping the compact Rollout panel prototype here. Main concerns: keyboard focus order when opening version detail drawer, and tiny rollback CTA copy. figma.com/...

Jon: On compact density the version rows collapse and the focus ring is almost invisible. Repro: Tab into timeline -> press Enter to open details -> focus lands in dialog header but Tab cycles to the end of document instead of returning to the scrubber on close.

Mateo: I think the dialog is being mounted without saving previous activeElement. We should snapshot document.activeElement before open and restore on close. Also add focus-trap inside the dialog and aria-hidden=true on inert background.

Tara: Copy nit: rollback button text currently "Rollback to this". Users scan quickly; suggest concise label "Rollback" and then a short confirmation body: "Rollback to v3.4.0 — creates a new rollout with 100% traffic to this version." Also add an inline link "What happens next" that opens the rollout docs.

a11y-bot: Scan results: contrast ratio failure for compact focus ring (1.9:1). Multiple live regions found announcing the same scrub update. Suggest single polite live region for timeline scrubs and an assertive one for errors/successes. Ensure dialog has role="dialog" and aria-modal="true".

Rhea: Good. For the visual focus we could switch to using outline-offset + 3px solid highlight when in compact. That should meet contrast. Also wondering about the canary chips: when paused they look disabled; users might think they can't preview. Maybe change paused chips to a lower opacity with a dashed border and add offscreen text "preview paused" for SR.

Jon: Agree on dashed border. Also for scrubbing tooltips: rapid mouse scrubs flip the tooltip content and they flash in wrong order. We should debounce show for 120ms and cancel pending shows when a new scrub event arrives.

Mateo: For SR announce content, include full context: "v3.4.0 1 Canary 1 15% traffic. First change: fix token caching." Avoid short ambiguous labels.

Tara: UX question: do we want an undo after rollback? My vote: yes — show toast with "Undo" for 6 seconds and keyboard focusable. Add a confirmation modal only if rollback includes breaking changes (detected by changelog flag). For normal rollbacks keep it light.

Rhea: Good balance. Add toast UX to the spec and make undo keyboard accessible. We'll mark forced-confirmation only for flagged rollbacks.

a11y-bot: Reminder: toasts with Undo should be reachable by keyboard and not trap focus. Use role="status" and keyboard-focusable buttons. Also include aria-live="polite" for the toast body.

Jon: I'll prototype the focus-save/restore + dialog trap and push a branch. Mateo, can you implement the single live region for scrubs and debounce? Tara, please draft the rollback microcopy and the conditional confirmation copy.

Mateo: On it. I'll set debounce to 120ms and make the live region text include version + percent + first bullet changelog.

Tara: Drafted microcopy in Figma and linked it: figma.com/file/... I'll include the toast wording and the conditional modal copy.

Rhea: Great. Let's treat the focus + live-region fixes as patch priority and schedule the rollback undo/toast for next iteration. Thanks all.
